
```{r}
source("medication-lmer-utility.R")
source("plots.R")
```

```{r}
med_cols <- c("ACEi","ARB","BetaBlk","CCB","Diuretic","Metformin","Statin")
med_cols_rename <-c("ACEi","ARBs","β-Blocker","CCBs","Diuretics","Statins","Metformin")
disease_cols <- c('CVD', 'Endocrine', 'Psychiatric')
```

```{r}
AIBL_full_df_consist <- read.csv("../preprocessed_data/AIBL/AIBL_cdr_imputed_binary_consist.csv")
colnames(AIBL_full_df_consist)[colnames(AIBL_full_df_consist) %in% med_cols] <- med_cols_rename
NACC_full_df_consist <- read.csv("../preprocessed_data/NACC/NACC_cdr_imputed_binary_consist.csv")
colnames(NACC_full_df_consist)[colnames(NACC_full_df_consist) %in% med_cols] <- med_cols_rename
HABS_full_df_consist <- read.csv("../preprocessed_data/HABSHD/HABSHD_cdr_imputed_consist.csv")
colnames(HABS_full_df_consist)[colnames(HABS_full_df_consist) %in% med_cols] <- med_cols_rename
meta_full_df_consist <- read.csv("../preprocessed_data/meta/meta_analysis_cdr_imputed_binary_consist.csv")
colnames(meta_full_df_consist)[colnames(meta_full_df_consist) %in% med_cols] <- med_cols_rename
```


# correlation
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(GGally)
library(ggplot2)

# =============================================================================
# 1. FEATURE DEFINITIONS
# =============================================================================

binary_features <- c(
  "sex", "APOE4",
  "CVD", "Endocrine", "Psychiatric",
  med_cols_rename
)

continuous_features <- c(
  "CDR_change_per_year",
  "age",
  "edu"
)

plot_features <- c(
  continuous_features,
  binary_features
)

feature_labels <- c(
  "CDR_change_per_year" = "ΔCDR/year",
  "age"                 = "Age",
  "edu"                 = "Education",
  "sex"                 = "Sex",
  "APOE4"               = "APOE ε4",
  "CVD"                 = "CVD",
  "Endocrine"           = "Endocrine",
  "Psychiatric"         = "Psychiatric",
  "ACEi"                = "ACEi",
  "ARBs"                = "ARBs",
  "β-Blocker"           = "β-Blocker",
  "CCBs"                = "CCBs",
  "Diuretics"           = "Diuretics",
  "Statins"             = "Statins",
  "Metformin"           = "Metformin"
)
# CREATE PARTICIPANT-LEVEL DATASETS FOR EACH COHORT

AIBL_corr_df <- create_cdr_change_dataset(
  AIBL_full_df_consist,
  outcome = "CDR",
  id_col = "id"
)

NACC_corr_df <- create_cdr_change_dataset(
  NACC_full_df_consist,
  outcome = "CDR",
  id_col = "id"
)

HABS_corr_df <- create_cdr_change_dataset(
  HABS_full_df_consist,
  outcome = "CDR",
  id_col = "id"
)

# =============================================================================
# 10. MAKE ONE FANCY MIXED-TYPE HEATMAP PER COHORT
# =============================================================================

p_aibl <- plot_mixed_pair_heatmap(
  AIBL_corr_df,
  title = "AIBL: Mixed-Type Association Plot with CDR Change per Year"
)

p_nacc <- plot_mixed_pair_heatmap(
  NACC_corr_df,
  title = "NACC: Mixed-Type Association Plot with CDR Change per Year"
)

p_habs <- plot_mixed_pair_heatmap(
  HABS_corr_df,
  title = "HABS-HD: Mixed-Type Association Plot with CDR Change per Year"
)

# =============================================================================
# 11. SAVE FIGURES
# =============================================================================

dir.create("../plots/heatmap", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  "../plots/heatmap/AIBL_mixed_pair_heatmap.png",
  p_aibl,
  width = 18,
  height = 18,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/heatmap/NACC_mixed_pair_heatmap.png",
  p_nacc,
  width = 18,
  height = 18,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/heatmap/HABS_mixed_pair_heatmap.png",
  p_habs,
  width = 18,
  height = 18,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```
